At one stage I included all of the libs in the zap.jar file, but I took them out so
that they could be updated more easily.
All the jars in the lib directory need to be on the classpath - fix to follow shortly
(with any luck).

Thanks for letting me know!

issue.title: ZAP 2.4.3 crashing within Kali Linux

repository.name: zaproxy
repository.description: The ZAP by Checkmarx Core project

issue.body:
Yesterday, I did an apt-get update && apt-get dist-upgrade, and ZAP now fails to work.

The UI loads, but when the progress bar fills, the screen goes black and I get forcibly logged out.  I log back in (as root), and start ZAP again.  As before, the UI loads and the progress bar fills.  At this point, the screen goes black and is replaced by the following message "Error in /usr/lib/xorg/Xorg free() corrupted unsorted chunks: 0x0000559937b40f20"  The system is completely hung at this point, and I have to power off the box.

I'm running the latest version of Kali Linux (Kali Rolling 2016.1).  Results of uname -a are below:
`Linux kali 4.3.0-kali1-amd64 #1 SMP Debian 4.3.5-1kali1 (2016-02-11) x86_64 GNU/Linux`

Thanks for any help you can provide.  A similar issue has been entered on the bugs.kali.org website.

issue.title: add-marketplace-sorting

milestone.description: Enhancements and bug fixes expected to be included in the next main release.

repository.name: zaproxy
repository.description: The ZAP by Checkmarx Core project

issue.body:
Setup auto row sorter for installed and uninstalled addons tables in the
marketplace dialog. This is most handy in the uninstalled section if you
want to change to name sorting (vs. the default quality-name), or if (in
either table) you want the list reversed.

Add StatusUI component to be leveraged elsewhere for status/quality 
info. View now initializes a map (AddOn.Status, StatusUI), and exposes 
a getStatusUI method.
